Name: Artifacts Deserve to Be Displayed - Artifact Price Multiplier
Author: SnPie
Description:
[line]
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]

Have you ever wondered why museum-worthy artifacts sell for so little?
Or felt that rare discoveries deserve a bit more value?

[b]Artifacts Deserve to Be Displayed[/b] was made for exactly that — and yes, I wanted it too!
Give your artifacts the value they deserve and make every discovery feel a little more rewarding.
[line]
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install SMAPI.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]2. Download 'Artifacts Deserve to Be Displayed' and extract the archive. [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]3. Extract the mod folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]4. Launch the game through SMAPI.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]5. Adjust the settings through config.json or Generic Mod Config Menu if desired.[/color]
[line]
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Configurable artifact sell price multiplier. [/*]
[*]Apply changes to [color=#00ff00][size=4][b]vanilla artifacts only[/b][/size][/color], or to [color=#00ff00][size=4][b]all artifacts including mod-added ones[/b][/size][/color].[/*]
[*]Optional configurable minimum sell price guarantee. [/*]
[*]Settings can be changed through GMCM during gameplay.[/*]
[*][color=#ff7700][size=4][b]English [/b][/size][/color]and [color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Korean [/b][/size][/color]support.[/*]
[/list][line]
[b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Required[/b]: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.5.0 or later.[/*]
[*][b]Optional[/b] ( Not strictly required, but highly recommended)
-  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] : Allows you to change the mod settings through an in-game configuration menu.[/*]
[/list][line]
